notes: SKIPPED: THERE IS NO 1.20.1 BUILD OF BYG, ON ANY LOADER. Oh The Biomes You'll Go, mod id byg, is CurseForge project 247560. Its full published file list was pulled and every one of its 194 files was checked: the complete set of Minecraft versions it has ever shipped for is 1.12.2, 1.15.2, 1.16.1, 1.16.2, 1.16.3, 1.16.4, 1.16.5, 1.18, 1.18.1, 1.18.2, 1.19, 1.19.2, 1.19.3 and 1.19.4. There is NO 1.20 entry of any kind - not 1.20, not 1.20.1, not Forge and not Fabric. Its newest release is Oh_The_Biomes_You'll_Go-forge-1.19.4-4.0.1.3.jar, 38 MB, uploaded 2024-11-24. It is also absent from Modrinth entirely: the project slugs byg, oh-the-biomes-youll-go and biomesyoullgo all return 404 from the Modrinth v2 API, and a Modrinth search for the title returns only two Macaw's compatibility addons, not the mod. No jar was downloaded and no ids were invented, so item_count_in_jar is 0 and both the chain and collections are empty. THE REPLACEMENT IS ALREADY RESEARCHED. The same team's successor is Oh The Biomes We've Gone, which does have a 1.20.1 Forge build (Oh-The-Biomes-Weve-Gone-Forge-1.8.0.jar), and it is covered in full in biomeswevegone.json in this folder - 887 items, 54 biomes, 17 structures of which six are villages with loot, and three mobs. CRITICAL: THAT MOD'S ID IS biomeswevegone, NOT byg. Its META-INF/mods.toml declares modId biomeswevegone, so nothing from it may be emitted under a byg: prefix - every byg: id would be a dead reference in a 1.20.1 pack. This file exists only so the negative result is recorded rather than looking like a gap in the slice. autoquestgen.py's _load_researched_chains requires 4+ rows, so an empty chain here is skipped, which is the correct outcome.
